contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [C] PIV ESVT[ETRICVS CAES] ; R/ [---]S AVG

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate, Copy of issue of Tetricus II (272-274), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Beardless radiate bust ?cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [C] PIV ESVT[ETRICVS CAES]. Reverse description: Figure standing with spear in left hand and right hand extended. Reverse inscription: [---]S AVG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 15.4mm, Weight: 1.49gms, die axis: 12
